g.text: Cost tracks compute, but spans three orders of magnitude at any scale

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: recorded training cost against recorded training compute, for every notable model that carries both. The

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: dashed line is the median rate, so points below it bought their compute more cheaply than the typical model in the set.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, Data on AI Models (CC-BY) — notable_ai_models.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-models

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI models documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: 178 of 1043 notable models record both values. The median rate is 10¹⁸ FLOP per 2023 dollar, which is a summary of the middle of this

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: cloud and not a price: the cloud spans several orders of magnitude at any compute level, because it mixes rental and amortised-

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: hardware accounting and spans a decade of falling hardware prices. Epoch's cost figures are estimates for most rows, not disclosed

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: spend, and they cover the training run only — no research, salaries, data or failed runs.
